summary: Presents application-specific routing requirements for urban low-power and lossy networks, where sensing and actuating nodes are placed outdoors in cities to improve living conditions and monitor things like environmental rules. It informs what routing protocols must support.

eli5.summary: Many tiny sensors around a city need to send readings with little power. This note lists what a routing method must handle for such networks.
